mason1999_pardalis_ccb.citation: Mason, M. C., Kerley, G. I. H., Weatherby, C. A. & Branch, W. R. (1999) Leopard tortoises (Geochelone pardalis) in Valley Bushveld, Eastern Cape, South Africa: specialist or generalist herbivores? Chelonian Conservation and Biology 3(3):435-440

method.ko: 남아프리카공화국 이스턴케이프 Addo 일대 농장에서 1994년 12월~1996년 1월 직접 섭식 관찰 147회와 분변 52점의 육안·표피 현미경 분석 (오래된 스캔 PDF의 OCR 본문 확인)
method.en: 147 direct feeding observations and 52 faecal samples (macroscopic and epidermal microhistology) on farms near Addo, Eastern Cape, South Africa, Dec 1994 - Jan 1996 (OCR text of an old scanned PDF)

mason1999_pardalis_ccb.read: free PDF on the Chelonian Research Foundation website; Abstract, Tables 1, 2 and 4, Discussion

kabigumila2001_pardalis_afrjecol.citation: Kabigumila, J. (2001) Sighting frequency and food habits of the leopard tortoise, Geochelone pardalis, in northern Tanzania. African Journal of Ecology 39:276-285

method.ko: 탄자니아 세렝게티 국립공원과 인근 마을에서 1993년 10월~1996년 6월 직접 섭식 관찰 124회(먹이 항목 139개)
method.en: 124 direct feeding observations (139 food items) in Serengeti National Park and nearby villages, northern Tanzania, Oct 1993 - Jun 1996

kabigumila2001_pardalis_afrjecol.read: open copy in the University of Dar es Salaam repository; Table 2 (plant species in the diet)

joshua2008_chersina_phd.citation: Joshua, Q. I. (2008) Seasonal effects on the feeding ecology and habitat of Chersina angulata. PhD thesis, University of the Western Cape

method.ko: 남아프리카공화국 웨스트코스트 국립공원과 다센섬에서 1998~2000년 초점 개체 관찰, 분변의 육안·조직 분석, 우연 관찰로 먹은 식물과 부위를 정리 (표 6.5; 먹지 않은 이용 가능 식물도 함께 수록)
method.en: Focal observations, macroscopic and histological faecal analysis and incidental observations in West Coast National Park and on Dassen Island, South Africa, 1998-2000 (Table 6.5, which also lists available plants that were not eaten)

joshua2008_chersina_phd.read: thesis PDF in the UWC repository; Table 6.5 (pp. 144-146)

tftsg_sulcata_2020.citation: Petrozzi, F. et al. (2020) Centrochelys sulcata (Miller 1779) - African Spurred Tortoise, Sulcata Tortoise. Chelonian Research Monographs 5 (IUCN/SSC TFTSG), doi:10.3854/crm.5.110.sulcata.v1.2020

setlalekgomo2017_ajcb.citation: Setlalekgomo, M. R., Gaoganetswe, M. & Selebatso, T. (2017) The diversity of tortoises and their diet in Tswapong North, Botswana. Asian Journal of Conservation Biology 6(2)
